section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measurement of body dissatisfaction using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale. Participants rated photographic images of women using dropdown menus to indicate their current and ideal body figures. Body dissatisfaction was operationalized as the absolute difference between current and ideal ratings, consistent with previous studies, which have shown good patterns of validity and test-retest reliability for this measure.
